name: Qoder CLI
desc: Coding agent that runs in the terminal
desc_zh: 在终端里运行的智能体编程工具
solves: Opening an IDE is heavy for a quick fix; the same agent now works from any shell, script or pipeline.
solves_zh: 小改动还要开编辑器，现在在任意终端、脚本或流水线里就能直接派活。
best_for: You are already in a shell on a server or container and want an agent to fix, test and commit.
best_for_zh: 你正停在服务器或容器的命令行里，想让智能体直接改完、测完再提交。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://changelog.qoder.com/llms.txt, https://blog.qoder.com/llms.txt）。 Backfill: released before the 2026-05-07 window and absent from the ledger (the ledger only has Qoder@2025-08-22, the IDE). Separate product in the official family list (docs.qoder.com/product-series/what-is-qoder). CN edition 'Qoder CN CLI' shares the date 2025-10-15 (Aliyun help log).
